card.name: Absorption interactions with metal-containing products
card.fires_on: Words and numbers inside drug-interaction text about antacids, iron, zinc, or binders that reduce absorption. It fires on the hour count in spacing instructions, on commas in lists of metals, and partway through drug names like omeprazole.

modes.label: Metal cation lists
modes.description: Commas and word parts in lists of metals such as magnesium, aluminum, iron, zinc, or the word cations.
modes.example: products containing magnesium, aluminum<<,>> iron or zinc, including antacids

modes.label: Hours before or after
modes.description: The number or space after 'at least' in instructions to separate doses from iron or binders.
modes.example: should be taken at least <<2>> hours before or after the supplement.

modes.label: Inside repeated drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names such as omeprazole, pantoprazole, moxifloxacin or concomitant in interaction tables.
modes.example: omeprazole ↑ o<<me>>prazole No dose adjustment needed for o
